name: Menu list
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Menu list. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Menu
settings.how: Create or edit a menu in Content > Menus, then select it here. Nest links to create dropdown levels. Preview both desktop navigation and the mobile menu.
